  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_2.3.10.7
    - patch
    - namedpipes
    - NIST800-171_3.5.3
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-2_2

    path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanManServer\Parameters
    name: NullSessionPipes
    data: ""
    type: multistring
